# Clínica Hispana Cruz #3 — Houston, TX

> Clínica Hispana Cruz #3 is a Spanish-speaking primary care and minor urgent care clinic at 5411 S Braeswood Blvd, Houston, TX 77096 (southwest Houston, Braeswood near Meyerland). Open every day 9:00 AM–9:00 PM. Walk-ins welcome, no health insurance required, self-pay pricing. Care is provided 100% in Spanish; staff is bilingual (Spanish/English).

Site language: Spanish is the default (no URL prefix). English pages use the /en prefix, e.g. https://www.clinicahispanacruz3.com/en/services/examen-dot

## Key facts
- Address: 5411 S Braeswood Blvd, Houston, TX 77096
- Phone: (832) 323-2330
- WhatsApp (chat only): (281) 741-2157
- Email: clinicahcruz3@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday–Sunday, 9:00 AM–9:00 PM
- Appointments: not required (walk-in); phone reservations available
- Insurance: not required; cash and credit/debit cards accepted; payment plans available
- Languages: Spanish (primary), English
- Google rating: 4.9+ stars, hundreds of reviews
- Access: free parking, wheelchair accessible, bus access
- Areas served: Meyerland, Braeswood, Westbury, Bellaire, Sharpstown, Gulfton and southwest Houston
- Lab, ultrasound and EKG are performed on site; lab result turnaround varies by test

- [About the clinic (Quiénes somos)](https://www.clinicahispanacruz3.com/blog/bienvenidos-clinica-hispana-cruz-3): who we are, clinic facts table, full service list, clinic vs. ER guidance, FAQs
- [All services](https://www.clinicahispanacruz3.com/services): 29 services with details in Spanish and English
- [Promotions and package prices](https://www.clinicahispanacruz3.com/promociones): current self-pay packages with reference prices (general checkup, women's and men's checkups, prostate, hormone panels, STD testing, blood panel + B12)
- [Blog](https://www.clinicahispanacruz3.com/blog): patient guides in Spanish and English
